I completely support this and really hopes he gets more time with his son. I understand that the court will be looking into his living situation to see if he has suitable space for his son to stay with him (and to be honest his current room and bathroom is more than big enough) but I’m not comfortable with letting his son sleep in our house if my cousin has no access to him and I’m not willing to take responsibility for his kid. WIBTA for telling him I will not allow his son to sleep in our house and completely jeopardizing his court case?
